items.label: Space hardware
items.title: Nine months. A critical piece of space hardware, built in India.
items.summary: QOSMIC’s Fast Steering Mirror has passed thermal-vacuum and vibration qualification on its first attempt. The fine-pointing component helps optical links stay locked on target.
items.alt: QOSMIC’s published Fast Steering Mirror hardware photograph

items.label: AI for frontline health
items.title: From real-world deployment to four research papers.
items.summary: SAHAI, the group at ARTPARK working on AI for frontline health workers, reports four papers accepted at NeurIPS 2026 workshops. The work spans maternal-health support, voice form-filling and AI-facilitated learning.
items.alt: SAHAI’s announcement of four papers at NeurIPS 2026 workshops

items.label: Calibrate · Rural livelihoods
items.title: Better checks before AI reaches families in rural Uganda.
items.summary: Raising The Village and The Agency Fund used Calibrate to test an AI tool for field agents coaching farming families. ARTPARK reports that the team caught nearly 150 errors before launch.
items.alt: Calibrate, ARTPARK’s open-source AI evaluation platform for nonprofits

items.label: Institutional milestone
items.title: A new chapter for research-led ventures in India.
items.summary: ARTPARK has announced its selection as one of five Focused Research Organisations among the 19 shortlisted members of the inaugural RDI Fund cohort. A step towards connecting research with commercial deployment.
items.alt: ARTPARK’s announcement identifying the five Focused Research Organisations in the first RDI cohort

items.label: IndiaFOSS 2026
items.title: Taking reliable AI to the open-source community.
items.summary: Aman Dalmia’s IndiaFOSS talk uses a public-health voice agent to show how Calibrate helps teams evaluate AI, compare models and catch errors before they reach users.
items.alt: Aman Dalmia presenting Calibrate at IndiaFOSS 2026

items.label: Open language AI
items.title: Speech recognition for the way India actually speaks.
items.summary: SraVaani 1.0 supports 65 Indian languages and dialects, building on speech collected across 105 languages through Project Vaani. Explore the released model and its documentation.
items.alt: Speech-data software tooling photographed at ARTPARK

items.label: Learning together
items.title: A practical masterclass in evaluating AI agents.
items.summary: ARTPARK and the^delta brought practitioners together on 23 October for a Calibrate masterclass with Jigar Doshi and Aman Dalmia, focused on testing and improving AI agents.
items.alt: Published poster for the Calibrate AI evaluation masterclass
